annotation.title_clean: Directive 2009/127/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 21 October 2009 amending Directive 2006/42/EC with regard to machinery for pesticide application
annotation.title_en: Directive 2009/127/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 21 October 2009 amending Directive 2006/42/EC with regard to machinery for pesticide application
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 310/29
annotation.summary_en: EU directive amending the 2006 Machinery Directive to add essential environmental protection requirements for the design and construction of pesticide application machinery, including leakage prevention, drift control, calibration, testing and instructions. It is not AI-specific; it concerns conventional machinery, including self-propelled and airborne equipment.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds environment to the 'essential health and safety requirements' definition in Directive 2006/42/EC
New Annex I section 2.4 sets requirements for pesticide application machinery
Manufacturers must assess risks of unintended environmental exposure and test for distribution and drift
Instructions must give information on use, maintenance and inspection
Member States must transpose by 15 June 2011 and apply from 15 December 2011
